propositions: Eight stray top-level directories exist in the ticket tracker with no CREATE events, flagged as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH by rebar fsck.
All eight directories are empty, uncommitted, untracked by git, and have no open file handles, indicating interrupted writes from process crashes.
Directory mtimes (5h–55h old) fall far outside the 30-minute live-writer window, ruling out concurrent in-flight writes as the cause.
rebar tracker-maintenance --clean must verify via --status that the foreign list equals exactly the eight triaged ids before executing removal, ensuring all-or-nothing semantics.
After sweep execution, fsck violations for MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH must drop from 9 to 0, with committed tracker HEAD and git status unchanged.
